svg.title: TOPAK D5 — Break-glass is an emergency seating
svg.desc: ADR-0052 retires the floor's break-glass exception, X1. The break-glass roster's quorum now seats a named person on a seat of kind emergency for one round, on an envelope prepared in advance by promotion; the seat's calls are admitted by the ordinary allowlist permit, it is not coupled to an Observer, its activation is a forensic-floor record, and the path is drilled. Ratified provisional on 2026.10.05 (Batch 34): in force and subject to redesign, resting on ADR-0050, with its exit stated.
svg.text: TOPAK · D5

ADR-0052 retires the floor's break-glass exception, X1. The break-glass roster's quorum now seats a named person on a seat of kind emergency for one round, on an envelope prepared in advance by promotion; the seat's calls are admitted by the ordinary allowlist permit, it is not coupled to an Observer, its activation is a forensic-floor record, and the path is drilled. Ratified provisional on 2026.10.05 (Batch 34): in force and subject
to redesign, resting on ADR-0050, with its exit stated.

text.tspan: Not built · BOOTSTRAP at the reference

svg.text: Provisional means: ratified, in force, subject to redesign, for a record that did not meet its own ratification condition and says on its face what it lacked (ADR-0029 A4). X1's retirement is in force on that basis: if ADR-0052 is redesigned, break-glass has no settled form until the redesign is ratified (ADR-0052 §9; G10 §1.2, §8). Everything here is one hand's: not reviewed by a reader other than the drafter. Anything citing it says "author-ratified, provisional".

text.tspan: The path: prepared by promotion, activated by the roster's quorum, one lease for one round (ADR-0052 §2, §3)

svg.text: In advance: an emergency seating is promoted like any other
seating, by the quorum of B5.
Emergency-only tools (to isolate, to roll back) are promoted ahead
of time, in the seating's own bundle.
Not built: at the reference the unsigned BOOTSTRAP path
prepares it (prepare_emergency).

text.tspan: The break-glass roster, issued by the anchors

svg.text: The roster and its quorum k are what the rules carry for break-glass
Whether the rules floor bounds k for activation, as R9 bounds a
promotion's, is open.
The seat, of kind emergency, in Run; the persons who may hold it, by key; its
envelope: "the domain's" by default, or named entry by entry; the labels a task for
it may carry; a drill mark (ADR-0052 §2, §6; EmergencySeating).
Several may exist; the roster's quorum activates one.
One lease, for one named person and one round, with the round's task by
digest and label. The roster members sign exactly that; every replica counts
distinct roster keys against the issued quorum.
No operator's request, no promotion's unanimity, no gate. That is the speed
break-glass exists for.
No field for the reason: it is unknown to the mechanism by construction (§5).

text.tspan: The person is told what is in it

svg.text: The round's tool list is the envelope, delivered at the start of the round and written to
the topic as its opening record (ADR-0048 §2).
What is delivered in the clear follows the bundle's delivery table, per seat kind: with no
row for emergency, the person is given handles (result 6, below).
Alphabet Consult, Actuate, Report, the kind's; the person's key is in the lease.
The envelope is fixed for the round: computed from the log at the activation's index. A
promotion during the round does not reach it; the next activation sees it.

text.tspan: The label forbids bind the person

svg.text: R5 to R7 (ADR-0047 F1 to F3) are forbids on Actuate whatever the seat's kind
A person holding the seat who has read untrusted content in the clear takes a destination
from a handle, like anyone else (§2). In an emergency that will be felt (Consequences).
Signed with the person's key, as a proof checked at decide and at apply; no bearer
token (§1; I48).
Admitted by R1-actuate-allowlisted over the envelope, an ordinary allowlist of
ADR-0049 entries: no exception (§2). B10 lets an emergency seat Actuate and author
nothing else.
R3-observer-live does not reach it: a thinker rule (§4).
Recorded on the round topic with seatKind, where the record said breakGlass

text.tspan: Read by everyone who can stop it (§4)

svg.text: The domain's operators, in its W(p); a cell Observer if one is seated and live;
the correlator.
A finding is a deny any of them can make. At the reference the operators read
only in that nothing stops them: there is no read path (I48).
At the round bound R; at the lease's ttl, at most T_persona on the local
monotonic clock (ADR-0031 A2); when the person ends it.
Sooner: at an epoch increment, or a targeted revocation by any operator of
the domain (ADR-0050 §4).
No successor, no renewal: an operator's Regrant or Renew naming the seat
is refused. Another round is another quorum.
This is the time box, on the clock the corpus already accepts for a lease. R8
stays withdrawn: no TTL is issued or read (ADR-0026 W1).

text.tspan: Recorded (§5): the activation is a forensic-floor record, F5

svg.text: Who approved, whom, on which seating, for which round, with the task's digest and label, and at the reference the envelope as computed and the drill mark. Erasure does not remove it (ADR-0028 F5; ADR-0013 NC-2), and it must outlive its round (NonComposition_A1.tla, M3). Every call

leaves its record on the round topic. The reason is unknown to the mechanism, by construction: why the quorum acted is a claim about the world, and a field for it would be prose nothing checks (ADR-0007). The person may Report a rationale; that is content, and no admit turns on it.
F5

text.tspan: The seat, the envelope, and two questions the reference raised
§1 · An emergency seat is held by a person, and its kind is

svg.text: A fifth seat kind, declared in the issued rules, Run only. It does not vote, draft or submit (ADR-0037 A3).
Only a person holds one, with a Persona record and a signing key, and no other seat in that round (ADR-0037 §7, A3). No model's Persona binds to
the kind: the seat binding emergency is for a person's Persona whose attestation is the roster's quorum (ADR-0016 A2).
The person acts, and no agent does. The mechanism cannot tell a person from a program holding the person's key; this is a rule about what is
seated, as for operators.
Mediated: a person is not confined (G10 §2.3). The envelope bounds the front door, and nothing here bounds what a person does elsewhere.
Its key does not depend on single sign-on (drafter's choice): an emergency path that needs the identity provider fails when the provider does.
Alphabets by seat kind (ADR-0037 §4 with A3 and A4; the struck provisional Run column omitted):
Read, Draft, Invoke, Emit, Submit
Consult, Actuate, Report
Read, Emit; Vote(deny) when on the veto roster
Consult, Report (heartbeats and findings)
Read, Emit, Vote
None; only Build seats vote
Regrant, Renew, AttestGates, EndRound, Revoke,
FenceEpoch (A4)
Regrant, Renew, EndRound, Revoke, FenceEpoch; no authoring variant
None: no emergency seat in Build; a promotion is
Build's way to add authority (§7)
Consult, Actuate, Report (A3)
B10 as linked by the reference: an emergency seat may Actuate and nothing else here (ADR-0041 A2; ADR-0037 A3):
§2 · The envelope is prepared by promotion, and activated by the roster's quorum (the record's table):
An emergency seating: the seat, the persons who may hold it, its
envelope (by default the domain's), and the labels a task for it may carry
A promotion
In advance
One lease on that seating, for one named person and one round, with
the round's task
A quorum on the break-glass roster the
anchors issued (ADR-0013 §1)
At the emergency

text.tspan: The domain's envelope, computed at activation (§2, R1)

svg.text: names revision A
Run entries t1, t2
names revision B
Run entries: in the envelope? (result 5)
its own bundle
emergency-only tools, e.g. isolate, roll back

text.tspan: Envelope = every Run allowlist entry of every revision a seating in force in the domain names, un-narrowed, with the

svg.text: Computed from the log at the activation's index and fixed for the round. It cannot go stale: a tool promoted yesterday is in it today, and nobody has to keep
an emergency envelope in step.
No entry is general-purpose: each tool is held to the channel its entry declares; a shell, or a client for any address, is admitted nowhere (ADR-0049 §5;
A deployment may prepare a narrower seating, named entry by entry, and is given exactly that.
Open: where two revisions in force declare one tool differently, which entry governs (the drafter's reading: the later promotion's).
At the reference the ordering replica computes it; the others take it, and only a named envelope is checked against the seating (I48 (b)).

text.tspan: Result 5 · Does an operator's seating count?

svg.text: An operator's seating feeds the emergency envelope. An operator
calls no tool, and its seating still names a revision; at the reference it
counts, so that revision's Run entries are in the envelope (G10 §3, result
ADR-0052 does not say whether it should. Open (G10 item 92).

text.tspan: Result 6 · Handles by default for a person
A person on an emergency seat is given handles unless the bundle

svg.text: says otherwise. The delivery table is per seat kind, and the load check
asks for rows for thinker and observer only (G10 §3, result 6; I48 (d)).
Without an emergency row the person gets handles and no bytes, and
nothing refuses such a bundle. Whether a table must have the row is
open (G10 item 92).

text.tspan: §3 · One round, and nothing after it

svg.text: An activation is scoped to the round (the custodian's decision). The lease is round-coterminous, as every lease is (ADR-0031 §2).
No successor and no renewal (drafter's choice on renewal). Another round is another quorum.
Why the round: R8 looked for a second clock because the approval was scoped to the epoch and not to a lease. The round was the time box all
along (Finding 3). R8, which needed trusted time, was withdrawn (ADR-0026 W1; ADR-0032 §2; ADR-0045 §6).

text.tspan: §4 · Not coupled to an Observer (ADR-0039 A2)

svg.text: R3-observer-live is a forbid on a thinker seat, and an emergency seat is not one, so it does not wait on a dead Observer, and no exemption is
written into R3 (Finding 4).
NoAdmitWithoutLiveObserver and UnreadBounded stay statements about Thinkers; their modules owe nothing. G9 item 49 is decided (G10 §7).
Nothing acts unobserved on an agent's judgment: what goes uncoupled is a person, seated by a quorum, for one round.
At least once in each domain in each epoch, and periodically after that (the custodian's decision). A new epoch asks for a new drill: it fences every
lease.
A drill is a real activation: the real roster, a real quorum, a real lease for one round, on a drill seating whose envelope holds one tool with no outward
channel. It proves the roster, the keys and the path, and can do nothing.
The period is counted in rounds of the domain, not in time (drafter's choice). An obligation with evidence that gates nothing: an emergency early in
an epoch is still an emergency.
Nothing at the reference counts it; the log can show it (I48; G10 item 92).
Stopping: Revoke, EndRound and the fence are ADR-0050's and need no emergency seat. Erasure, which stays the floor's one exception (D4). A
person acting outside the mechanism. Build. Whether the reason was good: the review after the round, by people.

text.tspan: and the two successors (ADR-0052 §9, R2, R5; G10 §3)

svg.text: Six properties, two over ghost truth the mechanism never reads (whether the holder is a person; whether a quorum stood behind a lease): every emergency lease had a roster quorum; none was granted by anyone but the roster, or renewed; its holder is a person;

no call by either seat is admitted outside its seat's allowlist, so no admit is by an exception; no Thinker's call without a live Observer (R3 untouched); every round the seat has had has its activation record.

text.tspan: Built at reference · five §9 behaviours seen
An activation by the roster's quorum, with no operator

svg.text: A seat of kind emergency, a Run seat issued Consult, Actuate and Report. An emergency seating names the persons who may hold it, its
bundle, its envelope and the labels a task may carry. An activation names one person, one round and the task, and carries the roster members'
signatures over exactly that; every replica counts distinct roster keys against the issued quorum and grants one lease. The unsigned grant
does not lease the seat

svg.text: By default every Run entry of the seating's own bundle and of every revision a seating in force in the domain names, computed at activation
and fixed for the round; or the entries a seating names. It is the round's tool list and its opening record. A call is decided against the revision
that holds its entry, and is admitted by R1, with no Observer live

text.tspan: The person acts, and no agent does

svg.text: The lease holds the person's key. Every action under it carries a proof signed with that key, checked at decide and at apply; there is no bearer
token to it

svg.text: An operator's Regrant or Renew naming the seat is refused, and so is an unsigned renewal. Another round is another quorum. Any operator of

an_emergency_lease_is_one_round;

text.tspan: What is recorded, and the drill

svg.text: Each activation is in the replicated state with its approvers, its seating's drill mark and its envelope, and has no field for a reason. The Actuate
record says seatKind; the admit is marked emergency. A drill seating takes the real quorum and admits its one inert tool
a_drill_is_a_real_activation_on_the_log; step 4
The linked floor has no X1-break-glass. A BreakGlassApprove is refused at apply, and a quorum of such approvals admits nothing
exception_count_is_one_under_r6;

ADR-0033 A12's table, as ratified (its "Proposed" speaks as of its drafting). 131 tests at 9c57221, five added in emergency.rs; 133 at 075b2e7 (A15). Trace validation was behind at A12 and was rerun at A14: spec/Mechanism.tla models an activation and rejects X1's approval, 82 traces matching (G10 §3). A

matching trace is drift detection on tested paths, not a refinement. Code: control.rs (EmergencySeating, Activation, ActivationRecord, Envelope::Domain | Named), state.rs (apply_activate), tests/emergency.rs.
(a) The seating is prepared by the BOOTSTRAP path (prepare_emergency, unsigned), which stands in for a promotion.
(b) The ordering replica computes the envelope; operators' seatings count (result 5).
(c) The person's Persona is the digest of the key, and the lease's principal is the key.
(d) A delivery table needs a row for emergency or the person gets handles (result 6).
(e) BreakGlassRules.tools and .actions are read by nothing now; the roster and its quorum are what an activation uses.
A seating prepared by promotion (ADR-0052 §9).
A socket path for a person's signed action: the agent socket's protocol carries no proof, so the person acts in-process, as the tests do (I48).
Anything that counts the drill: activations with the drill mark are on the log, by epoch; nothing counts them or reports them.
A read path for topics: operators read the emergency seat's topic only in that nothing stops them (G10 item 46).

text.tspan: The exit from provisional (ADR-0052 §9, R6; G10 item 92)

svg.text: The seating, a person's Persona and the operators who read the topic are ADR-0050's. Its exit: a first lease from a completed tally with a promoted seating; the first operators seated by an anchor
issuance; a Regrant at rung 1 or above; an operator's Persona record and lineage; a review (B5).

text.tspan: 2 · The seating is prepared by promotion at the reference

svg.text: §2's first step is made today by the unsigned socket, as ADR-0050's first seating is.

text.tspan: 3 · The two questions are answered in the record

svg.text: Whether an operator's seating is "a seating in force in the domain" for the envelope; whether a delivery table must have a row for the emergency kind.

text.tspan: 4 · A reader who is not the drafter has reviewed it

svg.text: No reader other than the drafter has. The custodian then records the exit by a History row (ADR-0029 A4).
A socket path for a person's signed action, and something that counts the drill.

Also open (Open obligations): the roster's k, and whether the rules floor bounds it for activation as R9 bounds a promotion's; how many persons a seating names, and whether the person seated may be on the roster
that seats them; the drill period's value, and the correlator fold that counts epochs without a drill (ADR-0051, Proposed); rows for the three modules in the binding table (G10 item 90).

text.tspan: Keep X1, and scope its approval to the round

Declined earlier the same day, and now given by the round bound R
Not taken (drafter's choice). The lease's field set is closed (ADR-0031 §1), and R3 and B10 are written over kinds. A kind says it in the place the floor reads

text.tspan: One envelope for each foreseen emergency

svg.text: Not required ⟨R1⟩. A deployment may prepare narrower seatings; the default is the domain's envelope, which needs no foresight about the emergency

text.tspan: A fixed generic envelope, naming one bundle revision

svg.text: Not taken ⟨R1⟩. It goes stale at the next promotion, and an emergency path that is out of date is found to be so during an emergency

text.tspan: A general-purpose tool in the envelope: a shell, or a client for any address

svg.text: Rejected. A tool is held to the channel it declares, in an emergency as at any other time (ADR-0040 §3)

text.tspan: Activation by an operator's regrant of a prepared seating

svg.text: Rejected. One operator would then add authority alone
Rejected. It is the path break-glass exists to be faster than, and a veto-seat outage blocks it

text.tspan: A reason field on the activation

svg.text: Rejected, by the custodian's decision. The mechanism does not know the reason, and a field would say it did

text.tspan: A drill as a precondition of a real activation

svg.text: Not taken (drafter's choice). It would refuse an emergency for want of a rehearsal. The custodian may prefer it; §6 is the only section that changes

text.tspan: The emergency Persona attested by single sign-on

svg.text: Not taken (drafter's choice). The path would fail with the provider

Costs the record states (Consequences): the person holds the widest authority in the domain for the round under the default envelope, bounded by the quorum that seated them, the one round, any operator's revocation and the label forbids; an emergency that needs a capability no tool in the domain has takes a promotion, as it did under X1; a person who holds the key, and the roster's quorum, must be available; an agent cannot be given more in an emergency; the label forbids bind
the person; a drill is a real quorum, every epoch in every domain; five accepted records moved, two by reversal; one author, one day.
